keyPhrases.text: Mia Katigbak plays Agnes with more elegant swagger
brings a great deal of insight
the actors become marionettes to his concept
The pacing overall is slow, and by the end arduous
comedic elements that are not especially intrinsic
The overall sense of clownishness undermines the characters' sophistication

reasoning: Review has more criticisms than praise. While acknowledging some positives like cast strength and directorial insight, it criticizes fundamental elements: slow/arduous pacing, lack of action, actors as 'marionettes,' and directorial choices that undermine the work. The tone suggests significant reservations outweigh the positives.
